test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the sentence containing a homonym of the highlighted word:

The historian referred to a **bailey **in the medieval castle design.

options.text: The farmer locked sheep in the bailey.
The outer bailey surrounded the fort.
The guard stood near the bailey.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "The farmer locked sheep in the bailey."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bailey"** in the context of the question refers to the outer defensive wall or courtyard of a castle, especially in medieval times. (महल का बाहरी आंगन या दीवार)

 
 
• **Example:** The outer bailey of the castle was surrounded by a deep moat.
 
 
 
• The word **"bailey"** in the correct answer refers to a proper noun or a name (it could also mean a holding pen for animals in some dialects). (नाम या स्थान का संदर्भ)
 
 
• **Example:** The farmer kept his livestock in the bailey next to the barn.
 
 
 
• Hence, the sentence in Option 1 contains a homonym of the word "bailey" from the question.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Option 2:** "The outer bailey surrounded the fort."

 
 
• Meaning: Refers to the defensive wall or courtyard of the castle. (महल के आसपास की रक्षा दीवार)
 
• **Example:** The outer bailey was fortified to withstand enemy attacks.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The bailey had wooden walls."
 
 
• Meaning: Refers to the courtyard of a medieval castle. (महल का बाहरी आंगन)
 
• **Example:** The wooden walls of the bailey were replaced with stone over time.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The guard stood near the bailey."
 
 
• Meaning: Refers to the defensive wall or courtyard of the castle. (महल के पास का स्थान)
 
• **Example:** The guard patrolled near the bailey to keep an eye on intruders.
 
 

40:Ta2f,
The correct answer is **Option 2 (Valuing consensus over critical thinking).**
